failure_modes.recovery: Read the proposal — accepted is idempotent in effect; settled rows never move back.
failure_modes.when: the proposal is not in 'proposed' state (already accepted or settled)

preconditions: Accepting records agreement only — settlement (money movement) is a later wave's rail.

description: Accept a settlement obligation recorded against your tenant as payee — moves status proposed to accepted and stamps accepted_at under the registry's transition guard. Calling it again on an already-accepted row is idempotent (accepted_at simply re-stamps); once a proposal reaches settled the guard refuses any further move, since settled is terminal. Recording agreement only: no money moves here, settlement execution is a later rail's door. NEXT: settlement_proposal_read to verify the accepted row.

id.description: The settlement_proposal id to accept, recorded against your tenant as payee (settlement_proposal_list shows them).

name: settlement_proposal_accept
